unlisted_practices: Using ML feature importance on ED operational throughput data to identify drivers of left-without-being-seen and target operational interventions (rapid triage, direct bedding, boarding reduction)

screen.reason: AI/ML was used retrospectively to identify feature importances/risk factors for LWBS, which then informed operational clinical throughput interventions (rapid triage, direct bedding, boarding reduction); the AI tool itself was not deployed, nor was an AI deployment practice evaluated.
